svg.text: D-Flip-Flop Stick Diagram — TG Master–Slave Register with Asynchronous Reset
SMIC 55 nm · VDD = 0.9 V · L = 60 nm · 1f = 0.25 µm finger (CLK inverter uses 0.5 µm fingers)
M1 horizontal · M2 vertical — no same-layer crossings
Taps to VDD/VSS are well/substrate ties. Feedback TG gates are phased opposite to forward TGs. Series PMOS pair in each NOR shares diffusion (no contact between the two fingers).
Storage loop: X→INV1→XM→NOR1→QM→TG2→X (master) and Y→INV2→QB→NOR2→Q→TG4→Y (slave) — two inversions each.
